description: Young American friends bought a which is a vintage pornographic comic book at flea markets. Though they didn't find out later... it was worth "3 billion dollar"! By a small mistake, their comic books leave with the moving of their neighbor, Mrs. Kim. Michael and Brad recklessly head to "Republic of Korea" to find the missing pornographic comic books. Will they ever find Mrs. Kim in 'South Korea' where 50 million people live? \*\*Original Webtoon:\*\* \[Ridibooks\](https://ridibooks.com/books/5254000001), \[Bomtoon\](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep\_list/findMrsKim), \[Lezhin\](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/finding\_mrs\_kim) \*\*Official Translations:\*\* \[English\](https://tapas.io/series/Finding-Mrs-Kim/info)
